/.heading: PokeSurvivor - Play Online and Plan Your Next Run
/.intro: Pick a Pokémon, survive the horde and build around the cards you find. Play in your browser or check partners, evolutions and run plans before you start.

/play.heading: Play PokeSurvivor Online
/play.intro: Launch the official game, check the controls and keep a direct game link handy if fullscreen or sign-in does not work in the embedded player.

/pokedex.heading: PokeSurvivor Pokédex - Find Your Next Partner
/pokedex.intro: Browse all 966 Pokémon in a compact collection grid. Hover, focus or tap a partner to compare its base stats, rarity and normal or shiny appearance.

/level-up.heading: PokeSurvivor Level-Up Cards and Move Evolutions
/level-up.intro: Find the next card for your run. Browse moves by partner, check evolution recipes, compare stat upgrades and understand boss rewards.

/tier-list.heading: PokeSurvivor Tier List - Make Your Own Rankings
/tier-list.intro: Create a personal S–D tier list with all 966 partners. Arrange the sprites, customize your rows and export your board as an image.

/types.heading: PokeSurvivor Types - Matchups and Weather
/types.intro: Check your active move against an enemy’s types. Learn how the game’s damage factors combine and when weather changes a useful matchup.

/gacha.heading: PokeSurvivor Gacha - Know Your Banner and Pity
/gacha.intro: Find your target’s region, check its rarity pool and understand the guarantees before using tickets. A guaranteed rarity is not a guaranteed Pokémon.

/achievements.heading: PokeSurvivor Achievements - Pick Your Next Goal
/achievements.intro: Check the requirements and rewards for all 130 achievements. Find a run objective, a collection milestone or a challenge to work toward.

/guides.heading: PokeSurvivor Guides - Your First Run and Beyond
/guides.intro: Survive your first run, plan a move evolution or hunt for a shiny partner. Choose a guide for the next decision you want to make, from spending tickets to saving an unlock.

/updates.heading: PokeSurvivor Updates - What Has Changed
/updates.intro: See what changed on this fan guide, explore dated game changes and find the pages affected. The game archive is kept separate from website updates.

/legal/privacy-policy.heading: Privacy Policy
/legal/privacy-policy.intro: How PokeSurvivor.me handles browser interactions, hosting requests, email and content loaded from the official game.

/legal/terms-of-service.heading: Terms of Service
/legal/terms-of-service.intro: The terms for using PokeSurvivor.me, an independent fan guide with links to a separately operated game.

/legal/copyright.heading: Copyright and Credits
/legal/copyright.intro: Ownership, permissions and credits for this site’s original content, third-party artwork and game names.

/legal/about-us.heading: About PokeSurvivor.me
/legal/about-us.intro: An independent fan guide for choosing a partner, understanding upgrades and planning your next run.

/legal/contact-us.heading: Contact Us
/legal/contact-us.intro: Reach the site maintainer about a correction, a website problem or a copyright concern at support@pokesurvivor.me.

/rankings.heading: PokeSurvivor Rankings - Survival Leaderboards
/rankings.intro: Browse saved official survival records by player, team and Pokémon. Switch between Solo and Group boards, compare periods and check when each board was captured.
